note: Generated by npm run catalogue:build; edit the sources, not this file. Primary is the boss's slayer XP. Each boss needs this much Combat XP from mobs before it spawns, so Combat XP per slayer XP = Combat XP required / slayer XP for the tier the rate bracket assumes (rate-defaults slayerXp: early T3, mid T4, late T5, or T4 where T5 is missing or Alpha-only). XP from the boss kill itself is not counted, so these are floors. Where the usual spawn grind is one mob (Crypt Ghouls, Pack Spirits, Zealots, Blazes), its kills and guaranteed drops are counted too: kills per slayer XP = Combat XP per slayer XP / the mob's Combat XP (data/sources/wiki-mobs.json). Tarantula has no single usual mob, so it counts Combat XP only.
